title: Wear App: Tiles not communicating with app on phone
symptom: When trying to enter carbs using the AndroidAPS tiles on a Galaxy Watch 4, the confirmation dialog no longer appears and the carbs are not sent to the phone. The issue occurs intermittently and is not fixed by reinstalling the wear app or resetting the watch.
cause: The current dev wear code is not compatible with xDrip watchfaces anymore (communication has changed). The tiles are part of the AAPS watch face and may not work when an xDrip watchface is active.
fix: Use an AAPS watchface (e.g., AAPS DigitalStyle) instead of an xDrip watchface. Also ensure the same version of AAPS and WEAR is used.
evidence_quote: current dev wear code is not compatible with xdrip watchfaces anymore (comm has changed) You must use the same version of AAPS and WEAR to keep it working
